newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile state oil, copper unions plan protest.
newsitem.headline: Chile state oil, copper unions plan protest.

text.p: Unions at Chile's state oil company Enap, copper giant Codelco and smaller copper firm Enami agreed Wednesday to hold joint protests against government plans to privatize Enap and Enami.

"This deal commits the three organizations to look for joint action and paralize (activities) if the government does not change its position after talks which will be held tomorrow (Thursday)," said Hernan von Hausen, president of the National Federation of Oil Workers which represents employees at Enap.
He was speaking after talks with the Federation of Copper Workers, which represents Codelco miners, and unions from Enami.
Von Hausen said the unions, which represent over 25,000 workers, will meet again May 18 to discuss their next moves.
Controversy over the privatizations were sparked last week when government plans to sell two refineries belonging to Enap were leaked to the press.
In the case of Enami, a special government commission is looking at ways to open the firm's smelting and refining complexes to private investment.
